spanish: Cuando hurta varón buey o cordero, y lo degüella o lo vende, cinco ganado pagará debajo del buey, y cuatro rebaño debajo del cordero.

findings.issue: שֶׂה is one animal from the flock, sheep or goat; cordero narrows it to a young sheep.
תַּחַת is open between under and instead of; debajo keeps only the spatial sense beside the repayment verb.
כִּי is an open conjunction (if, when, or because); Cuando selects only the temporal sense.
בָּקָר is the bovine herd; ganado can mean livestock more broadly than that herd beside the flock.
Qal imperfect, sequential perfect, and perfect are leveled to one Spanish present in the case.

notes: Counts, articles, 3ms actor, object suffixes, and piel repayment stay inside the tokens.
